title.hr: Autonomija 365 — kako sustav radi sam, godinu dana
title.en: Autonomy 365 — how the system runs itself, for a year

principle.hr: Sustav se ne održava ručno: svaki posao ima jednog vlasnika koji ga piše, satnicu koja ga pokreće i provjeru koja pada ako izostane. Ova stranica ne obećava rezultat — ona svakih šest sati izmjeri stvarno stanje u repozitoriju i pokaže što je otvoreno.
principle.en: The system is not maintained by hand: every job has one owner that writes it, a schedule that triggers it, and a check that fails when it does not run. This page promises no outcome — every six hours it measures the actual state of the repository and shows what is still open.

detail.hr: 49 javnih izvora; feedovi se čitaju na svakom ciklusu.
detail.en: 49 public sources; feeds are read on every cycle.

detail.hr: Osam gradskih kanala, devet deskova i hub /izdanja/ grade se iz arhive.
detail.en: Eight city channels, nine desks and the /izdanja/ hub are built from the archive.

detail.hr: news.json, arhiva i status svježine na kojima stoji AKTUAL MEDIA.
detail.en: news.json, the archive and the freshness status that AKTUAL MEDIA stands on.

detail.hr: Svaki zapis na main ide kroz deploy koji provjerava ugovore prije objave.
detail.en: Every commit on main goes through a deploy that checks the contracts before publishing.

detail.hr: Satni nadzor provjerava rokove i pokreće kanonskog pisca kad izostane.
detail.en: The hourly watchdog checks deadlines and dispatches the canonical writer when one is late.

detail.hr: Ova stranica i /zdravlje/ mjere stanje iz datoteka; ništa se ne popunjava napamet.
detail.en: This page and /zdravlje/ measure state from files; nothing is filled in from memory.

label.hr: Svaki gradski kanal ima barem 300 tekstova u arhivi
label.en: Every city channel holds at least 300 archived stories

label.hr: Najnoviji tekst u svakom kanalu nije stariji od 48 h
label.en: The newest story in every channel is no older than 48 h

label.hr: AKTUAL MEDIA slike šalje kroz vlastiti posrednik, bez zajedničkih zamjenskih ilustracija
label.en: AKTUAL MEDIA serves images through its own proxy, with no shared fallback artwork

label.hr: Popis dopuštenih hostova posrednika jednak je hostovima u feedu
label.en: The proxy allow-list matches the hosts actually present in the feed

label.hr: Svaki desk ima barem jednu sliku na objavljenoj stranici
label.en: Every desk page carries at least one image

label.hr: Središnji feed nije stariji od 6 h
label.en: The central feed is no older than 6 h

label.hr: Stranica postoji na hrvatskom i engleskom, s međusobnim poveznicama
label.en: The page exists in Croatian and English, linked both ways

label.hr: Svaka stranica ima barem 6 internih poveznica
label.en: Every page carries at least 6 internal links

focus.hr: Nijedna vijest ne smije izgledati kao druga. Slika iz izvora ide kroz posrednik, a vijest bez slike dobiva tihu plohu umjesto zajedničkog crteža.
focus.en: No two stories should look alike. Source photos travel through the proxy; a story without a photo gets a quiet plate instead of shared artwork.

deliverables.hr: Posrednik /api/img s popisom hostova jednakim feedu
deliverables.en: /api/img proxy with an allow-list equal to the feed

deliverables.hr: Deskovi: krugovi gradova i minijature uz svaki osvrt
deliverables.en: Desks: city circles and a thumbnail beside every review

deliverables.hr: Kanali: slika iz feeda u članku i u og:image
deliverables.en: Channels: feed image in the article and in og:image

focus.hr: Arhiva svakog kanala prelazi 500 tekstova, a svaka važna ruta ima engleski blizanac s istim brojevima.
focus.en: Each channel archive passes 500 stories, and every important route has an English twin carrying the same numbers.

deliverables.hr: 500+ tekstova po kanalu, bez skraćivanja arhive
deliverables.en: 500+ stories per channel, without trimming the archive

deliverables.hr: Engleski blizanac za svaku novu rubriku
deliverables.en: An English twin for every new section

deliverables.hr: Tjedni arhiv koji se sam dopunjava
deliverables.en: A weekly archive that fills itself

focus.hr: Agent smije zaključivati samo iz onoga što u repozitoriju postoji: naslov, izvor, datum i poveznica. Svaka tvrdnja mora imati put natrag do zapisa.
focus.en: The agent may reason only from what exists in the repository: headline, source, date and link. Every claim must have a path back to a record.

deliverables.hr: Dnevni brief sastavljen iz stvarnih zapisa, s poveznicom na svaki
deliverables.en: A daily brief assembled from real records, each with its link

deliverables.hr: Provjera koja traži rečenicu bez izvora i pada
deliverables.en: A check that hunts an unsourced sentence and fails

focus.hr: Sve što je objavljeno mora biti pronađeno: sitemape, IndexNow i feedovi bez ručnog popisa. Kad izvor padne, stranica pada na arhivu, ne na prazninu.
focus.en: Everything published must be findable: sitemaps, IndexNow and feeds without a hand-kept list. When a source fails, the page falls back to the archive, not to emptiness.

deliverables.hr: Sitemap i IndexNow iz istog izvora istine
deliverables.en: Sitemap and IndexNow from the same source of truth

deliverables.hr: Pad izvora ne mijenja broj objavljenih tekstova
deliverables.en: A failed source does not change the published count

focus.hr: 365. dan nije cilj nego kontrolna točka: sustav mora moći pokazati što je radio svaki dan, tko je bio vlasnik posla i gdje je stao.
focus.en: Day 365 is a checkpoint, not a finish line: the system must show what ran each day, who owned the job and where it stopped.

deliverables.en: An annual report built from real artefacts

deliverables.hr: Popis poslova koji su preživjeli bez ručnog popravka
deliverables.en: A list of jobs that survived without manual repair

deliverables.hr: Plan sljedećih 365 dana s istim mjerilom
deliverables.en: The next 365-day plan on the same measure

next.hr: Otvorene kriterije ne popravlja ova stranica: ona pokaže vlasnika. Popravak radi onaj workflow koji je za taj posao kanonski pisac.
next.en: This page does not repair open criteria: it names the owner. The repair is done by the workflow that is the canonical writer for that job.
